title: Delamanid
dek: A nitroimidazole prodrug (Ddn/F420), twice-daily in adults, QTc-active, pregnancy-usable relative to pretomanid. The D in BDLLfxC and in some 9-month mixes.
story: Delamanid is activated by the same Ddn/F420 network as pretomanid and then disrupts mycolate synthesis and respiration. Adult dosing is 100 mg twice daily (not Pa’s 200 mg once daily). Pediatric dispersible tablets and weight bands exist — this is one reason DLM shows up in <14 6-month constructs.

WHO 2025: BDLLfxC uses DLM when Pa is off-limits. Some 9-month modified regimens include D (BDLLfxZ). It is not in BPaLM. Do not add DLM to BPaLM “for luck” — overlapping nitroimidazole activation, more QTc, more pills.
Resistance: ddn/fbi/fgd1 LOF, cross-R with Pa common. Catalogue 2nd ed expanded DLM-associated variants. QTc monitoring with BDQ/FQ/CFZ is mandatory scheduling, not optional folklore.
deepTitle: Why it is not just “oral Pa”
deep: Different regulators, different pregnancy evidence (still limited, but WHO chose DLM-containing 6-month for pregnancy rather than Pa).
Albumin binding and malabsorption: take with food as labelled.
Hypoalbuminemia was a trial exclusion/warning — read the current monograph your NTP uses.

visual.caption: DLM is a twice-daily nitroimidazole sharing Pa’s activation network but occupying different regimen letters (BDLLfxC, not BPaLM).

example.title: Adding DLM to failing BPaLM
example.setup: Month 3 BPaLM, still positive, new ddn mutation. Proposal: add delamanid and continue Pa.

steps.title: Shared activation
steps.body: ddn LOF is not a Pa-specific sulk. DLM will not magically use another reductase.

steps.title: Stop the nitroimidazole class as counting drugs
steps.body: Rebuild on remaining BDQ/LZD/FQ integrity — or admit salvage.

steps.title: QTc
steps.body: If you still use DLM for some residual reason, you just stacked another QT drug on BDQ/MXF. Have a better reason than “add a D.”

example.takeaway: DLM ≠ a new mechanism versus Pa when Ddn is dead.

check.why: Do not swap Pa’s schedule onto DLM.
